settings.hero_description: Purity Coffee is a specialty coffee company focused on producing the healthiest coffee possible. They emphasize rigorous quality standards, starting from sourcing to roasting, to ensure every cup supports overall wellness.

settings.title: Thoughtful Sourcing
settings.description: Purity Coffee starts with the highest caliber and specialty-grade organic Arabica beans, hand-picked on fully traceable farms. They avoid chemical fertilizers and pesticides, and meticulously select defect-free beans.

settings.title: Rigorous Testing
settings.description: Every single batch undergoes multi-stage lab analysis to screen for mold, mycotoxins, pesticide residues, and heavy metals. Purity has invested over $300,000 in third-party testing, a level of diligence almost unheard of in the coffee industry.

settings.title: Purposeful Roasting
settings.description:
“Environmental sustainability has become a core principle of Purity, and the regenerative organic movement is our guide. It is holistic, involving soil health, biodiversity, animal welfare, and fair wages and working conditions”

~ ANDREW SALISBURY, FOUNDER

settings.title: Taste Without Compromise
settings.description: Through all this meticulous science, Purity still crafts a cup that’s complex and deeply satisfying — layered with natural notes of chocolate, nuts, fruits, and caramelized sugars.
